user.title: Connect your Blue Star account
user.description: Use the account from the Blue Star Smart AC app. After setup, the integration uses your local network to talk to the ACs.

reconfigure.title: Refresh your Blue Star devices
reconfigure.description: Sign in again to add newly paired devices or refresh their LAN keys.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the device inventory from Blue Star.
error.no_supported_units: The account has no units with a supported LAN profile.
error.different_account: This account does not contain any of the previously configured units.

abort.already_configured: Blue Star LAN is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Blue Star LAN devices were refreshed.
